info.title: wax API
info.description: Multi-tenant WhatsApp linked-device API. The admin key manages tenants and keys; tenant keys manage that tenant's instances (other tenants' instances answer 404). Requests may reach any node of a cluster.

raw.description: The decrypted protobuf message as protojson.

sender.description: In groups: the author of the messages.
